title: Content directories empty - dynamic routes will return 404
description: Blog and portfolio content directories contain only .gitkeep files. Dynamic routes for /blog/[slug] and /portfolio/[slug] will fail without content.
closure_evidence: release-audit confirms 2 published blog posts, 7 published portfolio dossiers, dynamic routes in sitemap, and production build succeeds

title: No deployment configuration - production launch blocked
description: No vercel.json or deployment config exists. Custom domain not connected. Cannot deploy to production without configuration.
current_evidence: vercel.json exists with nextjs framework, npm ci install, and npm run verify build gate; 2026-06-01 local DNS checks for kizevich.com and www.kizevich.com returned NXDOMAIN/host-not-found; final domain connection and actual deploy remain external owner actions

title: AI assistant and calculator are shells without backend logic
description: Two key conversion surfaces (services calculator and AI assistant) exist only as UI shells. No multi-step logic, no AI integration, no form handling.
closure_evidence: services calculator now computes scope complexity and mailto brief; site assistant is intentionally bounded local routing helper; production browser QA verified interactions

title: MDX utility not tested with real files
description: Content reader utility exists but has not been tested with actual MDX files. May have bugs in frontmatter parsing or content rendering.
closure_evidence: release-audit parses real MDX frontmatter/content for blog and portfolio collections; npm run verify passes

title: No specialized UI components for content types
description: All pages use generic PageShell. Missing specialized components: CaseCard, BlogPostCard, ProofChip, ServiceCard, etc.
closure_evidence: specialized DossierCard, proof presentation, project scope estimator, site assistant panel, route-specific links/assistant/services compositions, and source-trace proof UI are implemented

title: Hardcoded canonical URL may conflict with deployment
description: Canonical URL hardcoded to kizevich.com in site config. Will be incorrect if deployed to staging subdomain. Should use environment variable.
closure_evidence: src/lib/seo.ts resolves absolute URLs from NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL with siteConfig.url fallback; README documents the production environment variable

title: No image optimization strategy
description: No strategy for optimizing portfolio images. May cause performance issues with large images. Mitigation: use Next.js Image component when adding content.
closure_evidence: DossierCard image-backed proof assets render through next/image with fixed dimensions, alt text, and priority only on first proof item; release-audit validates asset existence and live img alt attributes

title: No error boundaries for client components
description: No error boundaries exist. Future client component errors may crash entire page. Mitigation: add error boundaries when client components are implemented.
closure_evidence: src/app/error.tsx and src/app/global-error.tsx provide route-level and root-level fallback screens; release-audit checks both files exist

title: Unified project assessment completed
description: Full project review across docs, code, runtime and visual artifacts concluded that ai-nikitka-portfolio is an EARLY BUILD: strong strategy and scaffold, but not yet a finished product because real content, calculator, assistant, deployment and visual implementation are incomplete.
